changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.result_run (id, source, state, analyzer_id, delivery_receipt_id, source_connection_id, source_message_id, operator_name, row_count, opened_at, last_activity_at, last_updated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.result_run_seq'), 'ANALYZER', 'OPEN', g.analyzer_id, rc.id, g.source_connection_id, g.source_message_id, g.operator_name, g.row_count, COALESCE(rc.accepted_at, g.opened), g.last_activity, now() FROM (SELECT ar.analyzer_id, ar.source_connection_id, ar.source_message_id, MAX(ar.instrument_operator) AS operator_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MIN(COALESCE(ar.last_updated, now())) AS opened, MAX(COALESCE(ar.last_updated, now())) AS last_activity FROM clinlims.analyzer_results ar WHERE ar.run_id IS NULL GROUP BY ar.analyzer_id, ar.source_connection_id, ar.source_message_id) g LEFT JOIN clinlims.analyzer_delivery_receipt rc ON rc.connection_id = g.source_connection_id AND rc.message_id = g.source_message_id; UPDATE clinlims.analyzer_results ar SET run_id = r.id FROM clinlims.result_run r WHERE ar.run_id IS NULL AND r.source = 'ANALYZER' AND r.analyzer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ar.analyzer_id AND r.source_connection_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ar.source_connection_id AND r.source_message_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ar.source_message_id;

rollback.sql: UPDATE clinlims.analyzer_results SET run_id = NULL; DELETE FROM clinlims.result_run WHERE source = 'ANALYZER';
